---
title: "Full-day"
subtitle: "Four parts, with a facilitator"
---

This format takes one day. It works on one field experiment, in which emails that differed only in the name that signed them were sent to public housing authorities in the United States, and on a claim of the original authors (OAs) that five analysts reanalysed for the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026). Across the day you work as analyst no. 6, and you leave with a report of your own, two marks on the class chart, one explored and one declared, and the place of your declared result on the curve of the original data and on the curve of the new data of the replication in the SCORE replicability study.

## How you work

:::: {.fmt-steps}

::: {.fmt-step}
### webR {.unnumbered .unlisted}

The slides carry every step of the tasks in cells that run R in the browser through [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/), a version of R compiled to run inside a web page, and the webR workspace, a page of the workshop's website, holds the same tasks. Without R and an IDE, or if your installation fails, you can do every task there, with hints and worked solutions, and obtain the same numbers as in the IDE workspace.

[Open the slides](slides.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the webR workspace](../../lab.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.fmt-step}
### R and an IDE {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Install R, Quarto and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) before the day, following the steps for your operating system.

[Setup](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.fmt-step}
### The IDE workspace {#the-workspace .unnumbered .unlisted}

Download the IDE workspace of the case study as a zip file, open its folder in your IDE and run its setup check. You do the tasks in its report, which you keep afterwards.

[The IDE workspace](before.qmd#the-workspace){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::::

The day runs in four parts, with a break after the first and the third and lunch after the second.
